gaps.title: Making charges
gaps.text: 3 of 7 rivals lead with a making charges offer (GIVA, Mia, Jewelbox). Gehna has no making charges message. If you run a festive offer, say it in making charges terms: it is how buyers compare.

gaps.title: Gifting
gaps.text: 4 rivals run gifting ads now. Gehna's "Gifting" ad returned 15x in the last 14 days, so it is proven: add Karwa Chauth, Diwali and Bhai Dooj gift versions (in the creative pack).

gaps.title: Delivery before the festival
gaps.text: CaratLane and Jewelbox promise quick or ready-to-ship delivery. Gehna has a ready-to-ship page but no live ad for it. Run it from Karwa Chauth to Diwali.

gaps.title: Talk to an expert
gaps.text: Jewelbox runs "Chat with our jewellery expert". 1,122 people clicked WhatsApp on Gehna's site in 3 weeks: a click-to-WhatsApp ad could catch high-value buyers.

gaps.title: Volume
gaps.text: GIVA and Candere run 400+ live ads each. Gehna runs about 40. More is not better, but 2 to 3 new festive ads a week keeps pace.

gaps.title: Where Gehna is ahead
gaps.text: No rival leads with hallmark and certified gemstone proof, which is Gehna's best message (trust strip designs return 7.7x). Keep it on every festive ad.
